name: Unwed And Pregnant
overview: The topic 'Unwed And Pregnant' invites believers to reflect on the universal need for righteousness, as no one is inherently righteous on their own. Every good and perfect gift, including the gift of life and grace, comes from God, who is unchanging and faithful. Yet, the heart must remain steadfast in love for God, as turning away from our first love is a serious concern, reminding us to seek His guidance and mercy in all circumstances.
